## Design note

The other kind of 90s hot hatch: torquey instead of peaky. Shorter and wider-tracked for its length than the Vireo, it pulls cleanly from 2500 rpm and turns in hard, and the short wheelbase plus a rear bar make it lift-off happy — trail the brakes into a corner and the tail comes round to meet you.

## How this car breaks

Light early-90s unibody with a short nose: there is very little crumple zone ahead of the transverse engine, so the radiator and cooling pack go early in any frontal. Long, heavy three-door doors and thin B-pillars make a T-bone nasty. Plastic bumpers and a steel hood are cheap to replace.

- manufacturer spec-class data for early-90s 2.0 L FF hot hatches (mass, dimensions, gearing)

- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 461 | 0.80 | 370 |
| pitch | 1751 | 0.90 | 1580 |
| yaw | 1838 | 0.92 | 1690 |

## Engine

2.0 L DOHC 16-valve I4, naturally aspirated, multi-point injection. Class-typical early-90s 2.0 L 16-valve hot-hatch four (~53 kW/L, ~107 kW at 6000 rpm, ~181 N·m at 4500): broad, flat mid-range rather than the high-rev cam step of the 1.6.

Peak **108 kW @ 6500 rpm**, **181 N·m @ 4500 rpm**. Idle 850 / redline 6800 / limiter 7000 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.12 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 22 N·m. Power-to-weight 94 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

5-speed manual, open front differential. Layout **FWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 250 N·m. Shift time 0.25 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.27 | 12.88 | 57 |
| 2 | 2.13 | 8.39 | 87 |
| 3 | 1.46 | 5.75 | 127 |
| 4 | 1.13 | 4.45 | 164 |
| 5 | 0.89 | 3.51 | 208 |

Final drive 3.94, reverse 3.30. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.284 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 336 kg | 1.50 Hz | 29800 N/m | 1900 N·s/m | 2850 N·s/m | 0.16 m |
| Rear | 201 kg | 1.65 Hz | 21700 N/m | 1250 N·s/m | 1880 N·s/m | 0.17 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 3.2°/g with 45% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.405 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 81377 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 30497 F / 21524 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **3000 F / 11700 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 3.2°/g, front share 45%. Bump stops 150000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.7° F / -1.0° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 3.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 256 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm → A = 22.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 103 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·22.9 cm²·0.103 m = **1793 N·m**
- Rear: 247 mm disc, pistons per side 34 mm → A = 9.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 98 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·9.1 cm²·0.099 m = **680 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1312 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.36×), rear needs 284 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.39×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 388 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.637** → delivered 1790 N·m front / 388 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 610 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 16.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 10.4 m → outer-front path radius 5.10 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.74 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.584 rad (33.5°)** (outer 29.0°, inner 39.3° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.5 rad/s.
